flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.

remark: click: Closing the cookie notice button
click: Clicking Book a free first visit button
wait: queued plan (5 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
click: Clicking the climbing waiver acceptance checkbox
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit button
analyze: the reference is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com for 2 November 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed with reference code PL-4821.
one_liner: booked a free first visit on the booking site
